scope: Background GC matching only; does not establish model reliability

parameters.background_method: Without replacement within split; exact rounded GC bucket when available, nearest available bucket otherwise; all deviations reported
parameters.window_policy: ACGT-only full input plus jitter; reject blacklist and chromosome-boundary overlap; backgrounds also exclude all relaxed raw peak spans

rationale: Dense grid improves worst split histogram total variation to below 0.015; fewer than 0.5% of matched pairs per split differ by more than 0.05 GC fraction. Acceptable for an exploratory training pilot; these are project judgments, not published ChromBPNet acceptance thresholds.
limitations: Some rare high-GC pairs differ by up to 0.17; inspect GC-stratified held-out performance
Nearby negatives may overlap within a split; denser grid is not independent-locus depth
No changes to scientific model gate
